text: The University of Texas at Dallas > Galaxy Galaxy. Galaxy is a centralized hub that connects applicants, students, faculty and staff to essential university systems. It provides access to Polaris and Orion for academic and application tasks, Gemini for financial and HR functions, and other key services like email and eLearning. APPLICANTS STUDENTS Routine Maintenance: Orion, Gemini FMS and Gemini HCM may. be unavailable due to routine maintenance on Sunday mornings between 2 a.m. and noon.
